# VTODO fixtures

Synthetic samples in the shape written by the named clients (property set,
`PRODID`, parameter style). They contain no real data. Replace or extend them
with exports from real clients (anonymised) when available
([#12](https://github.com/Tiliavir/haken/issues/12)).

`invalid-*` must be rejected; everything else must round-trip with all unknown
properties unchanged.
